title: Mallampati Score
sources: Mallampati SR et al. Can Anaesth Soc J 1985
purpose: One component of the airway exam — the oropharyngeal view on maximal mouth opening with the tongue protruded (patient seated, not phonating). Class ≥ 3 predicts a harder laryngoscopy.

tiers.label: Class I
tiers.description: Soft palate, uvula, fauces, and tonsillar pillars all visible

tiers.label: Class II
tiers.description: Soft palate, uvula, and fauces visible (pillars not)

tiers.label: Class III
tiers.description: Soft palate and base of the uvula visible

interpretation.label: Class III-IV is associated with an increased risk of difficult direct laryngoscopy
interpretation.detail: Poor sensitivity/specificity in isolation — combine with thyromental distance, mouth opening, neck mobility (e.g. LEMON or El-Ganzouri).
